# `CoderAIProvider`

## API identity

- Group/version: `coder.com/v1alpha1`
- Kind: `CoderAIProvider`
- Resource: `coderaiproviders`
- Scope: namespaced

## Spec

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `controlPlaneRef` | [CoderControlPlaneReference](#codercontrolplanereference) | ControlPlaneRef names the CoderControlPlane in the same namespace. The controller calls Coder with that control plane's operator token. |
| `type` | string | Type is the Coder provider type. Coder cannot change it after create. |
| `baseURL` | string | BaseURL is the http:// or https:// URL that Coder sends model requests to. It must not hold user info. The Secret in apiKeySecretRef must list its origin as an allowed destination. |
| `displayName` | string | DisplayName is the name that Coder shows. When empty, Coder shows the provider name. |
| `icon` | string | Icon is the icon URL or path that Coder shows. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Enabled turns the provider on or off in Coder. When omitted, the default is true. |
| `apiKeySecretRef` | [SecretKeySelector](#secretkeyselector) | APIKeySecretRef references the key in a Secret in the same namespace that holds the provider API key. The Secret must opt in to the credential Secret contract. |

## Status

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | ObservedGeneration is the generation the controller last processed. |
| `appliedGeneration` | integer | AppliedGeneration is the last generation whose spec Coder fully holds. |
| `providerID` | string | ProviderID is the Coder provider ID. |
| `enabled` | boolean | Enabled is the enabled flag of the Coder provider at the controller's last read or update of it. It is empty while Coder holds no provider of this object, or before the first read. |
| `createAttemptTime` | [Time](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.35/#time-v1-meta) | CreateAttemptTime is set before every provider create request. While it is set and ProviderID is empty, a create request can be in flight or already committed in Coder. |
| `credential` | [CoderAIProviderCredentialStatus](#coderaiprovidercredentialstatus) | Credential records the Secret value last sent to Coder. |
| `conditions` | [Condition](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.35/#condition-v1-meta) array | Conditions are Ready, Reconciling, and Stalled. |

### CoderAIProviderCredentialStatus

CoderAIProviderCredentialStatus records which Secret value was last sent to
Coder. It holds no secret data and nothing derived from it.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `secretName` | string | SecretName is the Secret name that was read. |
| `secretKey` | string | SecretKey is the key in the Secret that was read. |
| `secretUID` | string | SecretUID is the UID of the Secret that was read. |
| `secretResourceVersion` | string | SecretResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the Secret that was read. |
| `keyID` | string | KeyID is the ID that Coder gave the key. It is not the key. |
| `resendAttemptTime` | [Time](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.35/#time-v1-meta) | ResendAttemptTime is set before every key resend. While it is set, a resend can be in flight or already committed in Coder. |
